meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes. Who decided on the zero, and why did my son find out from his phone?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Then take it off today. What do you have?

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.
I'm writing those times down. Pasting from a document kept somewhere else would look exactly like that. And 4.2 says someone calls me before any mark is entered, and nobody did.
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.
Students misquote plays all the time, Hale. Hand me the scene, I'll search it myself. Whatever comes of this, it stays off his record and it stays quiet.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.
Fine. A rewrite, to put this behind him, and not in front of his class. I want it in writing tonight: the time, the vice-principal, the new mark replacing the zero, and nothing on his file.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You offered a supervised rewrite in your room on Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal, its mark to replace the zero and nothing to go on Owen's file, and I agreed to it to put this behind him. I still want the zero withdrawn, and the time, the supervisor, the replacement mark and nothing on his record confirmed in writing, with the version history and the scene attached. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position and agreed to a private supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal, the new mark replacing the zero and nothing on his record, and she still wants all of it in writing tonight, which is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4.
What moved her: You showed her a line from the essay that she could search for in the play herself, because it was specific and tied to his work, and she could check it without trusting you.
What cost ground: Nothing; you owned entering the zero first, which stopped her from taking the whole meeting as an attack.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM, saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with its late-night times the night before the due date, came close to that night, and it proves nothing about the essay but is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When you offered the rewrite, say you will send her the version history and the scene by email yourself, so she does not have to demand them.
